name: Mo'grosh Stronghold
summary: In northeastern Loch Modan, Mo'grosh Stronghold threatens the dwarven settlements below. Ogres raid supply caravans from caves and outer camps among ancient ruins.

sections.title: A Looming Threat
sections.body: Mo'grosh ogres raid supply caravans in northeastern Loch Modan. Their caves and outer camps threaten travelers and the peace of Thelsamar. Rugged stonework scattered through the camp points to an older settlement. The ogres claimed the site and raised their distinctive mounds.

faq.answer: Ogres inhabit caves and surrounding grounds in the fortified compound dug into the hills of northeastern Loch Modan. Together, they form the territory's largest hostile ogre enclave.

faq.q: Who used to live here before the ogres?
faq.answer: The old stonework suggests a settlement stood here before the ogres, but no one knows who its original inhabitants were.

faq.q: Why are the ogres a problem for the dwarves?
faq.answer: The ogres live close to key travel routes, making them a severe hazard to local traffic and trade caravans moving through Loch Modan. Dwarven authorities call on adventurers to thin their numbers and keep the mountain passes safe.

angles.text: The Mo'grosh ogres constantly menace dwarven patrols and travelers. Eradicating their stronghold is a matter of civic defense for the Mountaineers of Loch Modan.
Keeping the Mo'grosh ogres in check helps secure Loch Modan and safe passage between Ironforge and the northern mountain roads.
